assets.notes: blargg (Shay Green) SNES SPC700/APU test ROMs. They report results via blargg's standard text shell (Passed / Failed #N / Internal error), so the committed subset is verified by comparing the rendered screen CRC32 at a fixed frame against a human-approved PASS capture (NESER_CAPTURE_SCREEN). License is informal: these are freely-redistributable test binaries with no formal license file, recorded as unknown; author site http://www.slack.net/~ant/. Committed PASS subset (screen_crc goldens): 1-test_exec_from_io, 2-test_single_instr, 3-test_write_disable, test_speed, test_timer_speed_2, test_timer_speed3. Deferred candidates that currently FAIL in this emulator (tracked per #2876, not committed and not run as ignored tests): 4-test_ram_disable (code CC), test_ram_disable_ipl, spc_smp (Failed 02), spc_mem_access_times (screen unstable), spc_dsp6 (Failed 03), spc_timer (Failed 02), test_timer_speed, test_timer_speed2, test_timer_stop, test_timer_stop2, timer_at_power_reset, speed_2_freezes2. See the README-SNES candidate table for reasons.

variants.notes: Six visually-approved PASS ROMs, run by snes::integration_tests::rom_pass_fail_spc700 with the screen-CRC oracle (fixed frame 600 golden). tree_sha256 is the sorted per-file sha256 record hash; regenerate with scripts/compute_snes_rom_asset_integrity.py.
Optional local corpus placeholder. Committed CI subset and per-ROM oracle mapping are implemented in subsequent #2876 iterations.
